author: Susan Jenkins
text: I use an alcohol wipe first. I also use a cover. I shower without the sensor scrub my arm and dry off. Alchol wipe skin tac apply, cover.

author: Deanna Wawrzyniak
text: This is my concern as well. I've been on 10 day Dexcoms, but insurance only wants to cover 14 day Libre 3 now. I'm in AZ where it's well over 100° every day and I'm lucky if my Dexcom lasts for 10. I use Skin Tac and Skin Grip over patches too. I'd welcome any tips as well.
